gloss: tea snack; refreshment served with tea

definitions.gloss: tea snack; refreshment served with tea
definitions.explanation: A small snack or sweet served alongside tea. A traditional part of Japanese hospitality and tea-drinking culture.

examples.japanese: {茶請|ちゃう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煎餅|せんべい}→煎餅：04958_senbei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To serve rice crackers as a tea snack.

examples.japanese: {茶請|ちゃう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have something sweet to go with the tea?

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茶請|ちゃう}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Whenever I visit my grandmother's house, she always has homemade tea snacks ready.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea) + {請|う}け (receiving, accompanying). Refers to snacks served alongside tea to complement the flavor. In Japanese culture, offering tea with an appropriate snack is a basic form of hospitality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶請|ちゃう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to serve as a tea snack
- {茶請|ちゃう}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧: tea sweets
- {茶請|ちゃう}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: pickles as a tea snack

COMMON TEA SNACKS:
- ⟦{煎餅|せんべい}→煎餅：04958_senbei⟧: rice crackers
- ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧: steamed buns with sweet filling
- ⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧: sweet bean jelly
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: pickles (with green tea)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶菓子|ちゃがし}→茶菓子：17000_chagashi⟧: tea sweets — more specifically refers to sweets (wagashi) paired with tea
- {茶|ちゃ}の{子|こ}: tea snack — an older, somewhat literary synonym
- ⟦おやつ→おやつ：17921_oyatsu⟧: snack — a general term for between-meal snacks, not specifically paired with tea
